1) old age is detrimental to incidental learning of supra-span visuo-spatial sequence through immediate serial recall; 2) intentional learning instructions are beneficial to young adults but have no effect on older adults' performance; 3) older adults' poor performance in both learning conditions is due to their lack of ability to use knowledge of the repeated sequences to elaborate on their strategies.
